[[File:PROXY-TFU.png|thumb|[[PROXY]], a holodroid.]]
A '''PROXY droid''', or a '''holodroid''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] unit infused with sophisticated [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] technology. Holodroids could change their appearance and copy abilities at will. In this regard, they were similar to [[TC-SC infiltration droid]]s and the [[Jedi training droid/Legends|Jedi Training Droids]].

One such holodroid was [[PROXY]], companion of [[Galen Marek]] around the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Following his death, a [[Subject 1138|clone]] of [[Galen Marek]] was created on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] with the purpose of eliminating the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. As part of his training, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] ordered the clone to destroy a trio of [[Sith Training Droid|Sith training holodroids]] imitating [[Juno Eclipse/Legends|Juno Eclipse]] and a pair of [[Rebel trooper/Legends|Rebel troopers]] in order to test the [[Cloning/Legends|clone's]] willingness to destroy his [[Clone template/Legends|template's]] legacy. The clone easily eliminated the droids disguised as Alliance troops, but the imprinted memories and emotions of his progenitor prevented him from striking down the one disguised as Eclipse. Disappointed with the result of the test, Vader destroyed the droid and determined that the clone was another failure, no different than the other clones that couldn't free themselves from Marek's emotions.
